one_liner: Web scraping and data extraction API with AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) support.
access_notes: Free tier available instantly upon dashboard sign-up with 1,000 monthly tokens and no credit card required.
verdict_reason: MrScraper offers a fully self-serve free tier, extensive API documentation, and an official MCP server with public SDKs and straightforward API token authentication.

evidence.snippet: Include your API token in the x-api-token HTTP header on every request
The hosted server supports browser sign-in through OAuth 2.1.
Scraper Free includes 1,000 MrScraper tokens every month at no cost - no credit card required.
All API endpoints require authentication using an API token passed in the x-api-token header.
Official MrScraper MCP server: Scraper API for HTML, Markdown, and screenshots
Send scraper results directly to external services through webhooks.

agent_notes: The platform provides robust documentation, a clear developer portal, official SDKs, and an official MCP server.
